proves.claim: One renew call over the job route extends every job the runner holds and answers each job's new lease, and names a job it no longer holds as refused without failing the rest.

api.io-renew-batch.one-call-extends-all-.why: Without this test each runner goes back to one renew call per held job, and those calls load the board and slow every other call.

proves.claim: A claim answer for a runner whose cap holds back an open job carries a wait time, while an empty queue or a claim that takes a job carries none.

api.io-renew-batch.capped-claim-carries-.why: Without this test a runner at its cap polls claim every 2 s and loads the board for nothing.
